messages.author: 0bde143813deb68c
messages.subject: Device error
parts:
Hi all,

I ran a plot and it partly worked but had this error message that I have
not seen previously.

Below is error issue
> ggplot(All, aes(Date, Time, colour = Species)) +
+ geom_point() +
+ facet_grid(. ~ Species) +
+ opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) # so the date
labels won't overlap
> dev.off()
> ggsave("SecondPlot.png", width=30, height=20)
Error in grDevices::png(..., width = width, height = height, res = dpi, :
unable to start png() device
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In grDevices::png(..., width = width, height = height, res = dpi, :
Unable to allocate bitmap
2: In grDevices::png(..., width = width, height = height, res = dpi, :
opening device failed
> ggsave("twoPlot.png", width=60, height=30)
Error in grDevices::png(..., width = width, height = height, res = dpi, :
unable to start png() device
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In grDevices::png(..., width = width, height = height, res = dpi, :
Unable to allocate bitmap
2: In grDevices::png(..., width = width, height = height, res = dpi, :
opening device failed

Tnx for suggestions. Seems like it used to work some time back.

Bruce

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Device error
parts:
Hi,

Not sure but maybe w30 x h20 (inch) is too large, so it fails to
allocate memory.
try width = 3 and height = 2 instead.
